updates_entry: Removed orphan DisplayTogglePill / useGlobalDisplayPrefs, dropped 'use client' from CreatorLink, fixed PokemonDropdown reorder key, hardened useDarkMode toggle (stable closure), tidied FAQ keys.
summary: Wave 2A mechanical cleanups landed: (1) git rm of two orphan files plus the now-empty src/components/display/ directory (auto-removed by git rm). (2) Stripped redundant 'use client' from CreatorLink.tsx since it uses no hooks/events/browser APIs. (3) Replaced key={index} with key={`${mon.parsed.species}-${index}`} on PokemonDropdown's reorderable list. (4) Replaced stale-read pattern in useDarkMode toggle with !getSnapshot() (functional-update spirit; setDarkModeValue accepts boolean only, so used the store's getter). (5) Dropped the no-op useCallback wrapper in useTheme.ts — exported setTheme directly as setGenTheme, and removed the now-unused useCallback import. (6) Changed FAQ_ITEMS.map key from index to item.question (unique by data). (7) Skipped clearPublishError in useShareFlow.ts because it sits behind a prop boundary into DO NOT TOUCH files; removing useCallback would break memoization stability. tsc --noEmit clean, npm run build exited 0. No commit performed per instructions.
